title: English fleet scatters the Spanish Armada at Gravelines
summary: After fireships broke up the Armada's formation off Calais, English ships attacked it off Gravelines. Winds then drove the Spanish fleet into the North Sea.
reason: Philip II sent the Armada to escort an army from the Netherlands to invade England and end English support for the Dutch revolt.
significance: The failure of the invasion secured Protestant England and its rise as a naval power.
